general_information.Description: This course offers a comprehensive, yet approachable, guide to public relations plans for students. The knowledge and techniques presented and discussed in this text serve as an effective guide for enhancing students' public relations planning skills. Course objectives: Master the fundamental strategies, tactics, and tools of public relations and those who wish to learn them in the context of the rapidly changing entertainment industry: - Exhibit an advanced understanding of the relationship between entertainment and communication. - Exhibit an advanced understanding of the theories of humanities and social science - Plan a publicity campaign, manage public image, leverage the effects of digital media, and write a compelling press release - Construct professional media and communication practices
general_information.StudentTasks: - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Read the textbook in advance

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: To understand the relationship between entertainment and communication utilising perspectives from the humanities and social sciences.
To comprehend the requirements and skills necessary for creating effective public relations plans for a wide range of entertainment activities.
To be able develop and implement effective public relations plans for a wide range of entertainment activities with the utilization of AI tools
Show a constructivist approach to learning and/or the ability to work independently and collaboratively to accomplish assigned projects in a professional manner
Have the ability to work with a high level of professionalism, both in studying the subject and in applying it in reality; be well aware of AI Literacy and Responsible Communication

assessments.Question Type: Report (An in-depth analysis of an entertainment case study and suggested solution)
